description: Split of an area into resizable panels.

howToUse: Use it for two panels side by side whose width people adjust: list and detail, code and preview.
Pass the panels in `first` and `second`, the start size in `defaultSize`, and limits in `min` and `max`. Save the size in `onSizeChange` to keep it.
On mobile, show one panel at a time.
alternatives: A fixed split: a CSS grid.

keyboard.action: Moves it to the minimum or the maximum.

examples.label: Interactive
